title: Clash Arena Unique Statuses and some fixes

texts: Implemented Unique Statuses for most identities in clash arena. Secondary statuses have been merged into this system. Point values for identities have been updated.
Added a way to change which sinner's links are shown at the bottom of identity and e.g.o pages.
Fixed some issues with some text/statuses not being displayed properly in some identities.
Fixed company on the profile page not loading when the user has spaces in their username.
Fixed some settings in clash arena not syncing automatically from the host to the other players. This is purely visual.
